value.message: Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre has Tot Gym for 18mo-3.11yrs, drop-in Thursdays 9:30-12, fall session Sept 10-Dec 16 (no class Oct 10), $15 per visit, no pre-reg - their site says. They also list a Preschool & Kinderfun drop-in for under 4s from Oct 9, though no price posted. Want me to check details before you head over?
